name: scientist-os
description: Conversation-led scientific project work with portable evidence procedures and reproducible Python tools.

interface.shortDescription: Research through conversation, evidence and tools.
interface.longDescription: A portable scientific operating procedure for a capable local agent host. Maintains project continuity, controlled evidence, executable analyses and reviewable research artifacts. Host tools and the separately installed Python core supply execution; scientific approval remains with the scientist.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Scientist OS to start or resume my research project and carry out the work I describe.
